description: shale.md's 'Manifest and Metadata' section describes a manifest file tracking active WAL/segment allocation — no manifest exists in lib/bedrock/data_plane/log/shale/ (recovery reloads by scanning segments; cold_starting.ex). Other unverified-or-fictional claims: '64MB WAL size limit' and file rotation; 'large transactions stored in separate segment files with WAL references' (segments ARE the WAL; there is a 10MB per-transaction cap and recycler, not a two-tier scheme); 'Sync policies' and 'Configuration and Tuning' sections describing knobs that do not exist; 'timestamps and checksums per transaction' (checksums exist in transaction_streams.ex; verify the header description). Rewrite the Storage Architecture / Transaction Storage Process / Configuration sections against writer.ex, segment.ex, segment_recycler.ex, cold_starting.ex.
title: shale.md describes mechanisms that do not exist in the implementation
